prompt: As of 1st August 2024, Are the actors who play Summer and Luke in the OC in anything else together?
answer:
Yes. **Rachel Bilson (Summer Roberts) and Chris Carmack (Luke Ward) appeared together again in *Nashville***.

Bilson joined *Nashville* in its fifth season in 2017, while Carmack was already playing Will Lexington. Their reunion was publicized after Bilson shared a photograph with Carmack on the set. As of **August 1, 2024**, *Nashville* was the only notable post-*The O.C.* series in which the two actors worked together; they had not appeared together in another film or TV production.
